title: The bell, no school
logline: Last Bell week: the school from across the road, and this year the page draws the bell shape at the door with no one coming out — a Sunday, the page realizes, and keeps it. The bell for nobody.

panels.composition: A high school from across the road, doors shut, a jagged sound shape at the door, no students, a Sunday's empty lot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small-town high school seen from across a road with its doors shut and a jagged sound shape at the door, no students and an empty lot, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The bell for nobody. A Sunday.
